codeReview.summary: Fail. Commit `e61de4c` makes a plausible one-line fix in `frontend/src/root.tsx` by adding `suppressHydrationWarning` to the `<html>` element, which matches the reported dark-theme hydration warning. But the feature requirement was to verify that all primary routes render without blank screens or console errors. The recorded evidence does not show that: every primary application route except `/` is mounted under the protected layout in `frontend/src/routes.ts`, and `frontend/src/routes/protected-layout.tsx` calls `requireSignedIn()` before those route components can render. The handoff confirms the review session only observed redirects to `/sign-in` for `/accounts`, `/profiles`, `/lists`, `/workflows`, `/logs`, `/monitoring`, `/vnc`, and `/scraped-data`, so the actual pages were never exercised. That leaves the feature's core verification claim unmet.

issues.description: All protected primary routes require authentication before their UI can render, but the reviewed run only exercised the redirect path to `/sign-in` for `/accounts`, `/profiles`, `/lists`, `/workflows`, `/logs`, `/monitoring`, `/vnc`, and `/scraped-data`. Because those route components never actually rendered, the feature does not verify the assigned behavior ('All 9 routes render without errors'); see `frontend/src/routes.ts:10-19` and the handoff evidence at `C:/Users/yaros/.factory/missions/c159f8a2-f42a-48c7-bea6-166e5c18ca91/handoffs/2026-03-14T23-35-39-528Z__frontend-verify__e0e1fcf7-bae9-46d3-8409-3ccf12bc5b4c.json:34-66`.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The Windows `stop` commands in `.factory/services.yaml` are brittle under this Exec shell because the embedded PowerShell pipeline relies on `$_` inside double-quoted command text. The reviewed worker repeatedly hit variable-expansion failures when trying to use those commands to stop the dev servers.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: `C:/Users/yaros/Downloads/bot-auto-ig/.factory/services.yaml:16,23` define the server/frontend stop commands as `powershell -Command "Get-NetTCPConnection ... | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess ... }"`. The frontend-verify transcript skeleton shows repeated failures such as `InvalidOperation: The variable '$_' cannot be retrieved because it has not been set.` in `C:/Users/yaros/.factory/artifacts/tool-outputs/grep_tool_cli-call_5fedJicY8U61x9UYIZKumVhd-31609378.log`.

summary: Reviewed `frontend-verify` via mission metadata, handoff, transcript skeleton, skill/shared-state files, and git diff for commit `e61de4c`. The code change itself is a narrow hydration-warning suppression in `frontend/src/root.tsx`, but the feature fails review because the recorded browser checks only verified redirects to `/sign-in`, not the actual protected route UIs that the feature was assigned to validate.
